source: Windows CI run 45159836136 (phase 1 at 1039b44, PR merge commit b6e98fc): every suite present then produced exactly these outcomes on Windows. Added after 1039b44 and so far recorded on macOS only: test_app_paths.py, test_host.py, test_host_imports.py, test_window_layout.py, test_file_io.py, test_launcher_discovery.py, test_game_target.cjs, test_mac_task_tiers.cjs, test_task_tiers.cjs and the selector test in test_windows_contract.cjs; HostImportTests.test_win32_overlay_backend_imports is skipped off Windows and recorded with its Windows outcome (pass in runs on 06c9c07 and 00d5531), so a Windows-only regression there cannot hide behind a skip. Refresh from the offline-test-results artifact when Windows outcomes change.

macos registers no names rather than guessing by position without the mapping
windows pairs returned IDs with submitted tasks by position
every stop request is counted at once, before the stop itself is sent

tests: the tier list follows the controller: Adb on macOS gets the Android tiers, everything else the Mac tiers
Mac marks, wording and start gate are exactly the macTaskTiers ones
Android marks use the Android manifest and wording
an Adb instance on macOS waits for and checks the Android tiers only
whenSettled resolves at once, on the change that settles it, or at the timeout
the Android loader reads its own command and route and words its errors for Android
a controller attach_resource_path loads after the resource paths; none adds nothing
native Mac scheduling waits for the Mac tiers alone and never reads the Android tiers
a due Adb instance on macOS waits for the Android tiers, chosen by its selected controller
the scheduler starts a due native Mac instance at once while an Adb instance waits for the Android tiers
the scheduler runs a due native Mac instance listed after an Adb one even if stopped during the Android wait
an Adb schedule disabled during the Android tier wait is not started; the store is read again after it
a native Mac check in the next minute runs while an Adb instance of the minute before waits for the Android tiers
startup with only native controllers never requests the Android manifest; an Adb selection loads it once
a slot switched from Adb to native Mac during its Android wait is triggered once, even by an overlapping check
Windows sees only nikki_windows and builds the pinned Win32 controller config
built-in features select nikki_windows and connect with the pinned config
production loader on a Windows backend matches the pinned effective interface
